blocks.text: Isaiah 16 contains 14 verses. It opens with: Send ye the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion. It concludes with: But now Jehovah hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of a hireling, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and of no account.
